newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil plans Yme well conversion.
newsitem.headline: Statoil plans Yme well conversion.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it planned to convert an exploration well in the Gamma South-East segment of the Yme field in the North Sea to a producer.
The plan has been submitted to the Norwegian Petroleum Directorate for approval, Statoil's Status Weekly magazine said.
Drilled from the Yme production rig Maersk Giant, the well was found to contain hydrocarbons this autumn as part of an exploration programme near the main Yme Gamma West field.
Yme is currently producing about 33,000 barrels per day. Status Weekly did not say how much the new well would yield.
